prefix_oracle.label: decoded: for every payload that does not parse from byte 0 but closes a tag stream from byte 12, the int32 at byte 4 equals the export record's own name-table index

unknowns.what: the values of the 97 `BmScript.RVehicleBatmobile` class-default properties
unknowns.why: their payloads are fixed-size descriptors (oracle 2: one size for all 12 scalar properties, one for all 29 pointer/array properties) and three same-class properties are byte-identical apart from a counter (oracle 3); 96 of the 97 names never appear as a named property tag anywhere in the 20,128-object grab (measured below). So the defaults are not in these objects and not in the grab's tag streams; they would be in the class's serialized instance data or in `BmScript` (a package that is not shipped)

unknowns.what: the value of `XrayLightComponent`'s `StructProperty` at class offset 0x200 and the `ObjectProperty` at 0x13c on every prefixed CDO component
unknowns.why: the tags decode (type, class offset, payload size) but `OFFSETS.json` has no member names for these component classes, so which field each offset is stays UNKNOWN - that is the BmSDK-AK layout question G3-01 raised

unknowns.what: objects that are not reachable from the decoded vehicle chain
unknowns.why: no decoded reference chain from `Playable_Batmobile_SF`'s own vehicle objects reaches them. That is not proof of irrelevance (a class default or a native lookup could use one); answering it needs the runtime oracle (G3-07)

unknowns.what: the 6 CDO component payloads past the 512 MiB decode budget
unknowns.why: `PartialPackage` refuses them by design rather than guessing; raising the budget would decompress ~645 MiB of the Startup image
